# ArkWithWithdrawalRequest
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/ArkWithWithdrawalRequest.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../interfaces/i-ark-with-withdrawal-request.md), [ArkWithSwap](./ark-with-swap.md)

**Title:**
ArkWithWithdrawalRequest

**Author:**
SummerFi

Abstract base for Arks whose withdrawal path is asynchronous: a `requestWithdrawal` step
initiates the off-chain settlement, and a separate `sweep` (or `claimWithdrawal`) step
brings the underlying asset back to this Ark and forwards it to the FleetCommander's
buffer ark. Inherits the whitelisted-router swap utility (`_swap`, `_applySlippage`,
`whitelistRouter`, `setSlippage`, `_boardToBufferArk`) from `ArkWithSwap` for exits
that route through a DEX aggregator.

Concrete subclasses must still implement the abstract hooks defined on `Ark` (`_board`,
`_disembark`, `_withdrawableTotalAssets`, `_harvest`, `_validateBoardData`,
`_validateDisembarkData`) AND the async-withdrawal hooks declared on
`IArkWithWithdrawalRequest` (`requestWithdrawal`, `claimWithdrawal`, `withdrawUsingSwap`,
`isWithdrawalClaimRequired`, `withdrawalRequestId`, `assetsInWithdrawalQueue`). Slippage on
the internal `_swap` helper is bounded by `MAX_SLIPPAGE` and configured by the curator.


## Functions
### constructor

Wires the ark with its standard `ArkParams` and the initial swap-slippage tolerance.


```solidity
constructor(ArkParams memory _params, uint256 _slippage) ArkWithSwap(_params, _slippage);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|Standard ark configuration (asset, commander, deposit caps, etc.).|
|`_slippage`|`uint256`|Initial `_swap` slippage in basis points of `SLIPPAGE_BASE`. Must be `<= MAX_SLIPPAGE`.|


### sweep

Sweeps all underlying assets from the Ark and boards them to bufferArk

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function sweep()
    public
    virtual
    onlyKeeper
    nonReentrant
    returns (address[] memory sweptTokens, uint256[] memory sweptAmounts);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sweptTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the tokens swept|
|`sweptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the tokens swept|
